about.narrative:
Seasoned Java professional with 9+ years designing and building scalable, high-performance business applications — backend development, microservices architecture, and technical leadership, with a track record of improving software quality, system performance, and engineering workflows.

My way of working is rooted in systems thinking — a holistic view of the big picture together with the ability to dive deep into the implementation details of complex systems.

Hands-on experience working in various roles throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC).

A background in sales and project management gives me a perspective on delivering business value through technology — aligning engineering with product goals and communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Comfortable using AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools as productivity multipliers for technical research, design, development, debugging, refactoring, testing, and agentic engineering workflows.
highlights: Worked on a variety of projects, from large legacy systems to early- and mid-stage startups.
Worked with architectures from large legacy monoliths to complex distributed systems of dozens of microservices.
Worked with teams from small co-located groups to large international teams with hundreds of members distributed worldwide.
Strong in Java and its ecosystem, relational databases, and distributed systems.
Physics background and strong analytical skills.
